offering_description.value: Provides integrated payment processing and payment software for businesses in vertical markets such as healthcare, government and education. Sells to merchants and institutions, earning transaction fees, software fees and fees for bill payment and B2B payment services.

primary_products.value: integrated payment software; payment terminals; accounts payable payment platforms; bill payment portals

primary_services.value: payment processing; bill payment services; B2B payment processing; payment facilitation

customer_segment.value: B2B: merchants and businesses in healthcare, education, utilities and commercial sectors; B2G: government agencies and municipalities collecting fees and taxes

end_markets.value: healthcare; government; education; utilities; commercial and B2B payments

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: per-transaction and processing fees on card and electronic payments; subscription: recurring software and platform fees from merchant customers; service fees: fees for bill payment, onboarding and payment integration services
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: processes payments for merchants, taking in card and ACH transaction volume; software / platform: sells integrated payment software to vertical software providers and merchants; financial intermediary: facilitates payments between payers, merchants and card networks through sponsor banks
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: US national: Operates across the United States with customers in most states

specialization.value: related lines: payment processing, payment software and bill payment lines sharing merchant customers and technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to merchants and institutions; partners / resellers: software providers and integration partners embedding its payments; agents / brokers: referral and sales agents bringing merchant accounts
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; partners / resellers; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payment card industry security standards, card network rules, state money transmission rules and consumer protection and data privacy laws

notes: Description reflects general knowledge of the business and may not capture the latest portfolio changes.
